scope: Independent functional mapping witness only. Do not fit or change the mapping, QC, primary solver denominator, or scoring target.
partitions: For each of the 32 signed F1 root witnesses, inspect only its existing eight-second partition, in frozen root order. Scan joint-valid ticks from beginning to end.
selection: Within each split and side count original geometry with at least one thumb-other distance below the frozen 20 mm threshold. Keep the first such witnessed tick for each split/side. Also report the minimum observed raw distance for each stratum.
acceptance: Recompute the mapped vectors at those four possible witness strata with the unchanged train-only calibration and the original sample IDs. An unobserved stratum stays NOT_OBSERVED.
